verification_note: 2026-10-10 run: direct Firecrawl fetches (maxAge:0) of campusjobs.mlp.com's live 'Analyst' search (23 open jobs -- down from 24 on 2026-10-07; one new 2027 Quantitative Developer Intern posting surfaced, Tel Aviv, excluded as an internship), www.ares.com/careers and www.ares.com/us/careers/early-careers (both unchanged -- still exclusively the Dec 2027-Aug 2028 Summer Internship cohort, program start June 2027, no full-time Analyst/Graduate Program announced), a direct Ares Workday 'Analyst' keyword search (60 jobs, up from 59 on 2026-10-07), and targeted web searches for both companies (including a direct search for Millennium's 'Equities Analyst Program' and Ares' 'Analyst Program'/'Graduate Program' by name). Findings: (1) Millennium: no 'Equities Analyst Program' or any full-time entry-level Analyst role appears anywhere in the live campusjobs.mlp.com listing -- still closed, consistent with every run since the 2026-09-01 baseline. Web search surfaced MIT-career-office mirrors of the already-known closed 'Equities Analyst Program' postings (New York and Hong Kong, posted May 2025, targeting Dec 2025-June 2026 grads) -- these are stale listings for an earlier grad cycle, not new, and are not live on Millennium's own board. (2) Ares: five new 'Analyst'-titled postings surfaced on the Workday board this run (R7796 Real Estate Acquisitions/Self Storage, R8239 MAPS, R8541 Investor Services, R8618 Asset Management/Logistics, R6947 Fund Accounting). Pulled the full JD for the one most plausible candidate (R8239 MAPS, NY): requires 1-3 years of experience, confirmed experienced-hire. The other four are excluded on function mismatch alone (real estate, investor services, logistics, fund accounting -- none is the equity-research/investment-analyst archetype) without needing a full JD pull. The R5877-1 URL noted as a discrepancy in the 2026-10-07 run continues to 404 on Ares' own board -- not live, not re-added. Web search for an Ares 'Analyst Program'/'Graduate Program' by name turned up no results naming a 2027 full-time cohort; the only confirmed structured program remains the Dec 2027-Aug 2028 Summer Internship. No posting meeting BOTH the entry-level equity-research/investment-analyst archetype AND a directly-verified-live status for the Dec 2026-2027 grad window was found at either firm this run. No email was sent.
